name: AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS)
overview: AWS STS issues temporary security credentials for users, applications and federated principals to access AWS resources.
examSignals: Assume role/federate and obtain temporary credentials: STS
Define identity permissions and role trust: IAM
Workforce account SSO/permission assignments: IAM Identity Center

compareWith.diff: STS issues temporary session credentials; IAM defines roles, trust and permissions those sessions use.
